name: discord-presence
description: Unofficial: shows what Claude Code is doing as your Discord Rich Presence, and notifies you in Discord when a task finishes or needs you.

clientId.title: Discord Application ID
clientId.description: Application ID from discord.com/developers/applications; its name is what Discord shows as "Playing ...".

largeImage.title: Large image
largeImage.description: An art asset key uploaded to the application, or an https:// image URL. Empty: no image.

showProject.title: Show project name
showProject.description: Show the working folder's name in the status.

showFile.title: Show file names
showFile.description: Show the name of the file being read or edited. Everyone who sees your profile sees it too.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: Show how many dollars the session has spent so far.

showStats.title: Show session stats
showStats.description: The context bar ▰▰▱▱▱, a countdown to the 5-hour limit's reset when it is nearly used up, and prompts, files, commands on hover.

stateIcons.title: State icons
stateIcons.description: Show a small idle / thinking / working icon; needs art assets with those keys uploaded to the Discord application.

afkMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
afkMinutes.description: After this many minutes without a prompt, the status shows "💤 Away" and for how long. 0 turns it off.

webhookUrl.title: Discord webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: A channel's webhook, for the history of notifications (Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Direct messages come from the application's bot, whose token is kept in ~/.claude/discord-presence/bot-token.txt.

tagInChannel.title: Tag me in the channel
tagInChannel.description: Lead each channel message with your Discord tag, so a shared channel shows whose it is. It never pings.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Announce tasks that ran at least (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: A finished task is announced only when it ran at least this long. Questions, permission requests and errors are always announced.
